source: ledger kit v14, schemes_v20.py (booking scheme v20, financial transaction v8); the demo kit's own copy from here on (D48)

bookingSchemes.name: CASH_DEPOSIT_RECEIVED
bookingSchemes.note: v114 B0, M0, M7, M10a, M13a. Collected cash credited to the brokerage account; both clocks recognize it at once. On a margin brokerage account whose Cash is negative, the deposit reduces the margin debit by itself (M10a: −67,500 to −57,500): there is no paydown.

bookingSchemes.name: ACH_DEPOSIT_INITIATED
bookingSchemes.note: v114 D1. The deposit in transit on SL-CA (one pair); the good-faith amount (the originator's, capped by its own rule) credited to buying power at initiation. The withdraw clock waits for settlement. Credit - Uncollected Deposit (4003) carries the good-faith amount, at most the deposit: it is not a mirror of 1004 (B20).

bookingSchemes.name: ACH_DEPOSIT_SETTLED
bookingSchemes.note: v114 D2. Cash arrives; the SL-CA pair clears; the withdraw clock recognizes the deposit now (net equity up by the amount). On the trade clock the good-faith credit is replaced by cash; calculation 1, Difference(amount, goodFaithAmount), is the part the trade clock had not recognized, posted to net equity (zero in v114, where the good-faith credit was the whole deposit, so not written: J11).

bookingSchemes.name: ACH_WITHDRAWAL_INITIATED
bookingSchemes.note: v114 W1, M12a, M13b. A withdrawal, by any rail, from any brokerage account: a direct cash obligation. The hold pair in SL-CA; the withdraw clock encumbers it and the trade clock commits it at instruction, so both net equities fall now.

bookingSchemes.name: ACH_WITHDRAWAL_SETTLED
bookingSchemes.note: v114 W2, M12b, M13c. Cash out for the full amount; the hold pair clears; on both clocks the cash control falls and the encumbrance or commitment clears against it. No net-equity line: both clocks recognized the withdrawal at instruction. On a margin brokerage account Cash may go below zero (M13c: −57,120 to −62,620): the margin debit grows by the withdrawal.

bookingSchemes.name: ACH_WITHDRAWAL_CANCELLED
bookingSchemes.note: The mirror of the initiation: the hold pair, the encumbrance and the commitment clear and both net equities are restored. No workbook block; checked by the kit's own test.

bookingSchemes.name: EQUITY_BUY_ACCEPTED
bookingSchemes.note: v114 B1, C1, M1a, M4a, M8a. Hold and commitment at the estimate. The withdraw clock waits for execution. Whether the order is allowed was decided by the order management system before the transaction existed.

bookingSchemes.name: EQUITY_BUY_EXECUTED
bookingSchemes.note: v114 B3, M1b, M4b, M8b, posted per fill. estimatedAmount is the filled shares at the accepted estimate; the overage returned to the trade clock's net equity is calculation 1, Difference(estimatedAmount, fillAmount), not a transaction field. When the fill costs more than the estimate (a market order in a fast market) the overage is negative and its journal line posts on the other side (J12): net equity is debited by the difference. The withdraw clock recognizes the purchase now (encumbrance and net equity by the cost). The lot journal line binds Lot to the fill's financialTransactionId (field 1), so the lookup misses and a new lot ledger account opens with the fill's shares; the engine records the fill's amount and shares as the lot's reference (schema 11 R12).

bookingSchemes.name: EQUITY_BUY_SETTLED
bookingSchemes.note: v114 B7, M1c, M4f, M8c. The purchase is paid from Cash, in full, for a cash and a margin brokerage account alike. On a margin brokerage account Cash goes below zero when the purchase is financed (M1c: 25,000 to −15,000; M8c: 22,500 to −67,500): the negative balance is the margin debit. On both clocks the cash control falls and the encumbrance or commitment clears against it: no net-equity line, because both recognized the purchase at execution. No SL-SHARE journal entry: the lots were opened at execution.

bookingSchemes.name: EQUITY_SELL_ACCEPTED
bookingSchemes.note: v114 S1, C3, M4c. The sell hold, in shares: the order's quantity (field 8) is held in SL-SHARE against the security (net zero; the position control is unchanged). No effect on SL-CA or either clock. Whether the shares are free is the order management system's check: SL-SHARE 3002 less open sell holds (3004).

bookingSchemes.name: EQUITY_SELL_EXECUTED
bookingSchemes.note: v114 S3, M4d, posted per fill. Calculation 1 (IdentifyLotsNamed) takes the lots the fill names (field 18, chosen by the order gateway by the customer's disposal method) and costs each at remaining cost before less remaining cost after (schema 11 R12); it yields totalCost and realizedGain = grossAmount - totalCost (a sale at a loss gives a negative realizedGain, so the journal line posts on the other side, J12: 1202 is debited by the loss). Calculation 2 is Sum(secFee, finraTaf), calculation 3 Difference(grossAmount, totalFees). Cost basis, gain, total fees and net proceeds are not transaction fields. The trade clock credits the gross proceeds now and commits the fees (net equity up by the net proceeds); the withdraw clock encumbers only the fees. In SL-SHARE the sell hold is released for the filled shares, and the shares leave the position control and sit in 3003 against each named lot (one journal line per lot) until settlement. A fee of zero (M4d) writes no fee journal lines (J11).

bookingSchemes.name: EQUITY_SELL_SETTLED
bookingSchemes.note: v114 S7, M4e. Calculation 1 (SettlePending) relieves every pending share of the security from its lot: one journal line pair per lot. Calculation 2 is the net proceeds, Difference(grossAmount, totalFees). The withdraw clock recognizes the gross proceeds now (net equity up by grossAmount; the fee encumbrance clears against cash); the trade clock replaces its sale credit with cash and clears the fee commitment, with no net-equity line, because it recognized the proceeds at execution. Proceeds settle to Cash: on a margin brokerage account with a margin debit they reduce it (M4e: −15,000 to −9,875).

bookingSchemes.name: EQUITY_BUY_CANCELLED
bookingSchemes.note: v114 C2. The remaining hold and commitment released for the unfilled part of the order; releasedAmount is the originator's (the estimate of the shares still open).

bookingSchemes.name: EQUITY_SELL_CANCELLED
bookingSchemes.note: v114 C4. The sell hold released for the unfilled shares (field 8), in shares.

bookingSchemes.name: MARGIN_INTEREST_ACCRUED
bookingSchemes.note: v114 M11a. The accrual is the interest gateway's, computed on the margin debit (period, rate and average debit balance travel on the transaction for the audit trail). Both clocks recognize it at accrual, as they do fees: an encumbrance and a commitment, net equity down by the amount.

bookingSchemes.name: MARGIN_INTEREST_CAPITALIZED
bookingSchemes.note: v114 M11b. Accrued interest charged to Cash (−57,500 to −58,120: the margin debit grows by the interest). On both clocks the cash control falls and the encumbrance or commitment clears against it: no net-equity line, recognized at accrual.

bookingSchemes.name: EQUITY_SHORT_SELL_ACCEPTED
bookingSchemes.note: v114 SH1a. The trade clock commits the estimate: a short consumes selling power as a buy consumes buying power. No SL-CA line (no cash is spoken for) and no SL-SHARE line (no shares are held). The locate (field 13), the $2,000 minimum and the selling power check were the order gateway's before the transaction existed.

bookingSchemes.name: EQUITY_SHORT_SELL_EXECUTED
bookingSchemes.note: v114 SH1b, posted per fill. The short position opens at the proceeds (1107; no gain or loss until the cover) and the proceeds are receivable until settlement; fees are expensed and accrued as on a sale. The trade clock releases the order commitment for the filled shares (estimatedAmount, field 18), credits the proceeds (4002, the mirror of 1003) and commits them (4108, the mirror of 1107): net equity up by the released commitment less the fees (calculation 2), back to SL-CA equity. The withdraw clock encumbers only the fees. In SL-SHARE the short lot opens, keyed by this fill's financialTransactionId (field 1), against the short position control; the engine records the fill's grossAmount and shares as the short lot's reference (schema 11 R12).

bookingSchemes.name: EQUITY_SHORT_SELL_SETTLED
bookingSchemes.note: v114 SH1c. The net proceeds settle to Cash (calculation 1, Difference(grossAmount, totalFees)); the receivable and the accrued fees clear. The withdraw clock takes the cash in and encumbers the gross proceeds until the cover (5106), clearing the fee encumbrance: no net-equity line, so its net equity stays equal to SL-CA equity. The trade clock replaces its sale credit with cash. No SL-SHARE line: the short lot opened at execution.

bookingSchemes.name: EQUITY_BUY_TO_COVER_ACCEPTED
bookingSchemes.note: v114 SH4a. As a buy acceptance: the cash hold and the commitment at the estimate. Whether a closing order may skip the buying power check (up to the open short quantity) is the order gateway's rule.

bookingSchemes.name: EQUITY_BUY_TO_COVER_EXECUTED
bookingSchemes.note: v114 SH4b, posted per fill. Calculation 1 (IdentifyShortLotsNamed) takes the short lots the cover fill names (field 18) and relieves each at remaining proceeds before less remaining proceeds after (schema 11 R12); it yields totalProceeds and realizedGain = totalProceeds - fillAmount (a cover above the proceeds gives a negative realizedGain, so its journal lines post on the other side, J12: 1202 and Net Equity - Withdraw Clock are debited by the loss). The hold is released and the purchase owed until settlement. The withdraw clock releases the short's proceeds encumbrance and encumbers the purchase: net equity moves by the gain or loss. The trade clock swaps the order commitment for the purchase commitment (any overage, calculation 2, returns to net equity) and releases the proceeds commitment to net equity. In SL-SHARE the short position control closes for the filled shares and the shares sit in 3103 against each named short lot until settlement.

bookingSchemes.name: EQUITY_BUY_TO_COVER_SETTLED
bookingSchemes.note: v114 SH4c. The purchase is paid from Cash, as any buy settles; on both clocks the cash control falls and the encumbrance or commitment clears against it. Calculation 1 (SettleShortPending) relieves every pending cover share of the security from its short lot: one journal line pair per lot; a lot covered in full closes at zero.
